brief: c278 + c274, promoted. probes/bonfire-year.mjs threw on EVERY run for seven iterations — #178 deleted `bon.lit` out from under its toFixed and nobody noticed, because nothing runs probes/. #185 found it only because its brief told it to read the file. There are 281 files in .claude/skills/grow-courtyard/probes and 22 more probe-*.mjs loose in the repo ROOT — two trees, and SKILL.md names only the first, so a probe committed to the root one is invisible to the skill's own docs. Build a smoke-runner that executes every probe in BOTH trees against HEAD with a short per-probe timeout, and report how many pass, how many throw, how many time out, naming the throwers. The NUMBER is the deliverable: the loop has never known how much of its own instrument shelf still runs.
successLooksLike: One command, one table: N probes found across both trees, X pass, Y throw, Z time out, with the throwers named and the two trees told apart. A number nobody has.
avoid: This is the SATURATED sill x harness cell (9 entries, twice any other in the grid) and it is admissible only because it names a gate that failed SILENTLY for seven iterations and produces a number nobody has — do not widen it into a new gate, and do not wire it into the worker's per-iteration path, because a 300-probe run is a manager-cadence tool. Do not mass-fix or mass-delete what it finds; report, and fix only what the report makes trivially obvious. And note the labelling: this brief is HARNESS and will not touch courtyard.html, so runlog.mjs will read srcChanged:false. That is expected and is not a no-ship — say so in your ledger entry.
